en.t: Emperor Julian is fatally wounded near Samarra
en.s: On June 26, 363, Roman emperor Julian was wounded by a spear during fighting near Samarra, in what is now Iraq. He died from the injury a few hours later.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝尤利安在萨迈拉附近受致命伤
zh.s: 公元363年6月26日，罗马皇帝尤利安在今伊拉克萨迈拉附近交战时被长矛刺伤，数小时后因伤去世。

en.t: Pope Benedict II is consecrated as pope following imperial approval from the Byzantine Emperor. He is the last pope to require the confirmation of the emperor; the next popes require only that of the more closely situated exarch of Ravenna
en.s: Pope Benedict II (Latin: Benedictus II) was the bishop of Rome from 26 June 684 to his death on 8 May 685. Pope Benedict II's feast day is 7 May.

zh.t: 本笃二世获拜占庭皇帝批准后祝圣为教宗
zh.s: 本笃二世（拉丁语：Benedictus II）获拜占庭皇帝批准后，于684年6月26日祝圣为教宗，任罗马主教至685年5月8日去世。按原文记载，他是最后一位须经皇帝确认的教宗；后继教宗只需获得驻地更近的拉文纳总督确认。他的瞻礼日是5月7日。

en.s: The battle of Sherston was fought in Sherston, Wiltshire in England, from 25 to 26 June 1016. between the forces of King Edmund Ironside and Danish king Cnut as a part of Cnut's invasion of England. The West Saxons, fighting for Edmund, were victorious against the Danish and their English allies.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 舍斯顿战役于1016年6月25日至26日在英格兰威尔特郡舍斯顿爆发，交战双方是埃德蒙·艾恩赛德国王和丹麦国王克努特的军队，是克努特入侵英格兰的一部分。支持埃德蒙的西撒克逊人击败了丹麦军队及其英格兰盟友。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Köse Dağ took place in eastern Anatolia on 26 June 1243 when an army of the Sultanate of Rum, led by Sultan Kaykhusraw II, confronted an invading Mongol army under the general Baiju and was decisively defeated. The battle was the pivotal event of the Mongol conquest of Anatolia: Rum, previously a significant independent power in the eastern Mediterranean, was reduced to the status of a client kingdom, and its territories were later absorbed into the Mongol Ilkhanate.

zh.s: 科塞山战役于1243年6月26日在安纳托利亚东部爆发。罗姆苏丹国军队由苏丹凯霍斯鲁二世率领，与拜住将军指挥的入侵蒙古军交战并遭到决定性击败。这场战役是蒙古征服安纳托利亚的关键事件：此前在东地中海颇具实力的罗姆苏丹国沦为附庸国，其领土后来被并入蒙古伊儿汗国。

en.t: Przemysł II is crowned King of Poland in Gniezno
en.s: On June 26, 1295, Archbishop Jakub Świnka crowned Przemysł II King of Poland in Gniezno Cathedral.

zh.t: 普热梅斯瓦夫二世在格涅兹诺加冕
zh.s: 1295年6月26日，大主教雅库布·希温卡在格涅兹诺大教堂为普热梅斯瓦夫二世加冕为波兰国王。

en.s: The Battle of Blidebro (Danish: Slaget ved Blidebro, Swedish: Slaget vid Blidebro) was a battle between Danish–German and Swedish–Holsteinian forces near Copenhagen in 1342 during the Kalundborg War. The battle ended in a Danish–German victory and it is estimated that 350 Swedes were killed in the initial action.

zh.s: 1342年，丹麦—德意志联军与瑞典—荷尔斯泰因联军在哥本哈根附近的布利德布罗交战。这场战斗是卡伦堡战争的一部分，以丹麦—德意志联军获胜告终。据估计，约有350名瑞典人在战斗初期阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Casalecchio took place on 26 June 1402 near the town of Casalecchio di Reno, near Bologna, in northern Italy. At this battle, a Bolognese army under Giovanni I Bentivoglio opposed Gian Galeazzo Visconti, Duke of Milan, and his allies, the Malatesta of Rimini and the Gonzaga of Mantua. The city of Bologna was aided by the Republic of Florence in the struggle to halt the expansion of Visconti's power. The Bolognese-Florentine army was under Muzio Attendolo. Visconti was aided by many Italian lords and condottieri. The commander in chief was the famous leader Alberico da Barbiano.

zh.s: 卡萨莱基奥战役于1402年6月26日在意大利北部博洛尼亚附近的卡萨莱基奥迪雷诺爆发。乔瓦尼一世·本蒂沃利奥率领的博洛尼亚军队与米兰公爵詹·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂及其盟友、里米尼的马拉泰斯塔家族和曼托瓦的贡扎加家族交战。佛罗伦萨共和国支持博洛尼亚，试图阻止维斯孔蒂扩张势力。博洛尼亚—佛罗伦萨联军由穆齐奥·阿滕多洛指挥。维斯孔蒂得到许多意大利领主和雇佣兵队长支持，总司令是著名将领阿尔贝里科·达·巴尔比亚诺。

en.s: The Battle of Kokovo was a battle fought in the fields near the village of Kokovo (present-day Coccau in Italy (German: Goggau) on 26 June 1478 between an army of 600 peasants and miners from Carinthia against a 20,000-strong Ottoman Turkish invading army. The peasant army was raised in the context of the Carinthian peasant revolt of 1478.

zh.s: 科科沃战役于1478年6月26日在村庄附近的田野爆发，地点现属意大利科卡乌（德语名：戈高）。一支由克恩滕农民和矿工组成、约600人的军队，对抗一支约2万人的奥斯曼土耳其入侵军。农民军是在1478年克恩滕农民起义背景下组织起来的。

en.t: Richard III becomes King of England
en.s: Richard III (2 October 1452 – 22 August 1485) was King of England from 26 June 1483 until his death in 1485. He was the last king of the Plantagenet dynasty and its cadet branch, the House of York; the former had ruled England since 1154. His defeat and death at the Battle of Bosworth Field marked the end of the Middle Ages in England.

zh.t: 理查三世成为英格兰国王
zh.s: 理查三世（1452年10月2日—1485年8月22日）于1483年6月26日起担任英格兰国王，直至去世。他是金雀花王朝及其分支约克王朝的最后一位国王；金雀花王朝自1154年起统治英格兰。他在博斯沃思原野战役中战败身亡，标志着英格兰中世纪的结束。

en.s: The siege of Rhodes of 1522 was the second and ultimately successful attempt by the Ottoman Empire to expel the Knights of Rhodes from their island stronghold and thereby secure Ottoman control of the Eastern Mediterranean. The first siege in 1480 had been unsuccessful. Despite very strong defenses, the walls were demolished over the course of six months by Turkish artillery and mines.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1522年，奥斯曼帝国第二次围攻罗得岛，最终成功驱逐圣约翰骑士团，控制其岛上据点，从而确保奥斯曼帝国掌控东地中海。1480年的第一次围城未能成功。尽管罗得岛防御严密，土耳其军队仍在六个月内通过炮击和挖掘地道摧毁城墙。

en.s: The Battle of Chausa was a notable military engagement between the Mughal Emperor, Humayun, and the Afghan ruler, Sher Shah Suri. It was fought on 26 June 1539 at Chausa, 10 miles southwest of Buxar in modern-day Bihar, India. Sher Shah Suri was assisted by his allies, the Ujjainiya Rajputs of Bhojpur, as well as the Lohtamia and Gautam Rajputs who were led by the commander, Gajpati Ujjainia.

zh.s: 乔萨战役是莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍与阿富汗统治者舍尔沙·苏里之间的一场重要战斗，于1539年6月26日在乔萨爆发，距今印度比哈尔邦的布克萨尔西南约10英里。舍尔沙·苏里得到盟友支持，包括博杰布尔的乌贾尼亚拉杰普特人，以及由指挥官加杰帕蒂·乌贾尼亚率领的洛塔米亚和高塔姆拉杰普特人。

en.t: Francisco Pizarro is assassinated in Lima by the son of his former companion and later antagonist, Diego de Almagro the younger. Almagro is later caught and executed
en.s: Francisco Pizarro, 1st Marquess of the Conquest (; Spanish: [fɾanˈθisko piˈθaro]; c. 1478 – 26 June 1541), was a Spanish conquistador, best known for his expeditions that led to the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire. Born in Trujillo, Spain, to a poor family of pig farmers, Pizarro chose to pursue fortune and adventure in the New World.

zh.t: 皮萨罗在利马遇刺，小阿尔马格罗后来被处决
zh.s: 1541年6月26日，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在利马被昔日同伴、后来成为对手的迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗之子刺杀；小阿尔马格罗后来被捕处决。皮萨罗（约1478年—1541年）是一名西班牙征服者，拥有征服侯爵头衔，以促成西班牙征服印加帝国的远征闻名。他出生于西班牙特鲁希略一个贫困的养猪人家庭，后来到新大陆寻求财富和冒险。

en.s: The Battle of Bicske happened on June 26, 1578, between the Ottoman army and the Habsburgs near Bicske. The Ottomans were victorious. On June 26, the Hungarian noblemen, Ferenc Nádasdy and Pálffy Miklós, launched a raid against the Ottomans. The troops joined the Hungarians from Érsekújvár and Tata. These troops met at Komárom and set out with an army of 1,600 men, including 700 cavalry and 900 infantry.

zh.s: 比奇凯战役于1578年6月26日在匈牙利比奇凯附近爆发，交战双方是奥斯曼军队和哈布斯堡军队，奥斯曼军获胜。当天，匈牙利贵族费伦茨·纳达什迪和米克洛什·帕尔菲率军袭击奥斯曼军队。来自埃尔谢克新城和陶陶的部队在科马罗姆与匈牙利军会合，随后1,600人的军队出发，其中包括700名骑兵和900名步兵。

en.s: The Castilian War, also called the Spanish expedition to Borneo, was a conflict between the Spanish Empire and several Muslim states in Southeast Asia, including the Sultanates of Brunei, Sulu, and Maguindanao.

zh.s: 1578年4月16日至6月26日，西班牙帝国与文莱等东南亚穆斯林政权交战；西班牙军队入侵婆罗洲，最终撤出。

en.s: The Siege of Le Catelet, also known as the Capture of Le Catelet, took place at the stronghold of Le Catelet, in Picardy, between 20 and 26 June 1595, as part of the Franco-Spanish War (1595-1598) in the context of the French Wars of Religion. After a short siege, the Spanish forces commanded by the new Governor-General of the Spanish Netherlands, Don Pedro Henríquez de Acevedo, Count of Fuentes (Spanish: Conde de Fuentes), took the French fortress, compelling its garrison to surrender, as part of his offensive of 1595. A few days later the Count of Fuentes and his forces continued with the offensive and took La Capelle.

zh.s: 勒卡特莱围城战又称攻占勒卡特莱，发生于1595年6月20日至26日，地点在皮卡第的勒卡特莱要塞，是1595—1598年法西战争及法国宗教战争的一部分。西属尼德兰新任总督、富恩特斯伯爵佩德罗·恩里克斯·德阿塞韦多率西班牙军队短暂围城后攻下法国要塞，迫使守军投降。这是他1595年攻势的一部分。几天后，富恩特斯伯爵及其部队继续进攻并攻占拉卡佩勒。

en.s: The siege of Shamakhi was a phase in the Ottoman–Safavid war (1603–1612) that resulted in the Safavid army's success and Shamakhi's return to Iranian rule after 28 years. During the siege, Baku and Derbent also surrendered to the Iranian army, allowing the Safavid state to regain control of Azerbaijan and Dagestan. As a result, the Safavids were able to regain all the lands they had lost during the Ottoman-Safavid War of 1578–1590 between 1603 and 1607.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 沙马基围城战是1603至1612年奥斯曼—萨法维战争中的一场战事。萨法维军队成功围城，使沙马基在被奥斯曼统治28年后重新归属伊朗。围城期间，巴库和杰尔宾特也向伊朗军队投降，萨法维王朝由此重新控制阿塞拜疆和达吉斯坦，并收复了1578至1590年奥斯曼—萨法维战争期间失去的全部领土。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Storming of Kristianopel occurred on 26 June 1611, during the Kalmar War. Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden led an assault from the camp in Högsby in Småland on Kristianopel in Blekinge. The Swedes managed to siege the fortified city and went in by bombing the fortress port, which was badly defended. Right after the assault, there was a massacre of the city's population, with rape and pillaging.

zh.t: 克里斯蒂安诺佩尔城突袭
zh.s: 1611年6月26日，卡尔马战争期间，瑞典的古斯塔夫·阿道夫从斯莫兰省赫格斯比的营地出发，进攻布莱金厄的克里斯蒂安诺佩尔。瑞典军队围困这座设防城市，并炮轰防守薄弱的港口堡垒后攻入城内。突袭后，城中居民遭到屠杀、强奸和掠夺。

en.s: The action of 26 June 1625 was a naval battle that took place on 26 June 1625 near Syracuse, Sicily, when 6 Bizertan vessels defeated 5 Maltese galleys. On June 26th, while in harbor at Syracuse, the Maltese general, Tallamey, heard that six Bizertans had been sighted close at hand.

zh.s: 1625年6月26日，6艘比塞大船只在西西里锡拉库萨附近击败了5艘马耳他桨帆船。当天，马耳他将军塔拉梅在锡拉库萨港内听说附近发现了6艘比塞大船只。

en.s: The Third Battle of the Dardanelles in the Fifth Ottoman-Venetian War took place on 26 and 27 June 1656 inside the Dardanelles Strait. The battle was a clear victory for Venice and the Knights Hospitaller over the Ottoman Empire, although their commander, Lorenzo Marcello, was killed on the first day.

zh.s: 第五次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争中的第三次达达尼尔海峡战役于1656年6月26日至27日在达达尼尔海峡内爆发。威尼斯和医院骑士团取得明显胜利，击败奥斯曼帝国；不过，联军指挥官洛伦佐·马尔切洛在第一天阵亡。

en.s: Montecuccoli's landing on Funen occurred on 26 June 1659 when an allied force, consisting of six Dutch ships and 9,000 troops, attempted to land on Swedish-occupied Funen. The Dutch ships initially bombarded the Swedish positions and the Allied troops managed to land unopposed. These were later repulsed by the 4,000 Swedish troops under the command of Carl Gustaf Wrangel.
en.n: Montecuccoli's landing on Funen occurred on 26 June 1659 when an allied force, consisting of six Dutch ships and 9,000 troops, attempted to land on Swedish-occupied Funen.

zh.t: 蒙特库科利登陆菲英岛
zh.s: 1659年6月26日，一支联军试图在瑞典占领的菲英岛登陆，部队包括6艘荷兰船只和9,000名士兵。荷兰船只先炮击瑞典阵地，联军随后未遇抵抗就登陆。之后，卡尔·古斯塔夫·弗兰格尔率领的4,000名瑞典士兵击退了他们。
zh.n: 1659年6月26日，6艘荷兰船只和9,000名士兵组成的联军试图在瑞典占领的菲英岛登陆。

en.s: The siege of Tournai was an event in the War of Devolution. A French army commanded by Louis XIV successfully besieged the town of Tournai, then part of the Spanish Netherlands. The siege, which began on 21 June 1667, led to the surrender of the defenders loyal to the Spanish Empire fewer than five days later.

zh.s: 图尔奈围城战是归并战争期间的一场军事行动。路易十四率领法军围攻当时属于西属尼德兰的图尔奈。围城于1667年6月21日开始，不到5天后，效忠西班牙帝国的守军便投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Wesenberg took place on June 26, 1704 close to Rakvere (Wesenberg) during the Great Northern War. The Swedish cavalry force of 1,400 men under the command of Wolmar Anton von Schlippenbach retreated before Karl Evald von Rönnes larger force. However, the Swedes were caught at Wesenberg and after a valiant defense they had been close to annihilated with only 400 managing to escape towards Reval the rest was either killed or captured. The Russian losses are unknown.

zh.s: 韦森堡战役于1704年6月26日在大北方战争期间爆发，战场靠近拉克韦雷（当时称韦森堡）。沃尔马尔·安东·冯·施利彭巴赫指挥的1,400名瑞典骑兵面对卡尔·埃瓦尔德·冯·勒内率领的规模更大的俄军时撤退。瑞典军在韦森堡被追上，虽英勇抵抗，仍几乎全军覆没；仅400人逃往雷瓦尔，其余被杀或被俘。俄军损失不明。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Albany (about 26 June 1709) was an attack by French colonial volunteers and their native allies against the Canadian Hudson's Bay Company outpost of Fort Albany in the southern reaches of Hudson Bay. About 70 Frenchmen and 30 Indians attacked the fort, which was under the command of John Fullartine. Fullartine repulsed the attack, killing eighteen men including the leaders. He lost two men to ambush on their way back to the fort shortly after the attack.

zh.s: 奥尔巴尼堡战役约于1709年6月26日发生，是法国殖民地志愿兵及其原住民盟友对加拿大哈德逊湾公司奥尔巴尼堡哨所发动的袭击。约70名法国人和30名原住民攻击该堡，守军由约翰·富拉廷指挥。富拉廷击退进攻，打死18人，包括袭击方的首领。袭击后不久，两名守军在返回堡垒途中遭伏击身亡。

en.s: The Battle of Golden Rock was fought between forces of the British and French East India Companies on 26 June 1753, during the Second Carnatic War. French troops, assisted by Mysorean troops led by Monsieur Astruc, assaulted a British outpost near Trichinopoly, drawing the main British force defending Trichinopoly. The British, commanded by Stringer Lawrence, were victorious.

zh.s: 金岩战役于1753年6月26日在第二次卡纳提克战争期间爆发，交战双方是英国东印度公司和法国东印度公司军队。法国军队在阿斯特吕克先生率领的迈索尔军队协助下，袭击了特里奇诺波利附近的英军哨所，引出守卫特里奇诺波利的英军主力。斯金格·劳伦斯指挥英军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Short Hills (also known as the Battle of Metuchen Meetinghouse and other names) was a conflict between a Continental Army force commanded by Brigadier General William Alexander ("Lord Stirling"), and an opposing British force commanded by Lieutenant General William Howe. The battle took place on June 26, 1777, at Scotch Plains and Metuchen, New Jersey, during the American Revolutionary War. Despite the name, no fighting occurred in modern-day Short Hills, a section of Millburn. In mid-June General Howe marched most of his army into central New Jersey in an attempt to lure George Washington's Continental Army to a place where it might be better attacked than its defensive position in the Watchung Mountains.

en.s: The Battle of Spencer's Ordinary was an inconclusive skirmish that took place on 26 June 1781, late in the American Revolutionary War. British forces under Lieutenant Colonel John Graves Simcoe and American forces under Colonel Richard Butler, light detachments from the armies of General Lord Cornwallis and the Marquis de Lafayette respectively, clashed near a tavern (the "ordinary") at a road intersection not far from Williamsburg, Virginia. Lafayette had been shadowing Cornwallis as he moved his army toward Williamsburg from central Virginia. en.s: The 1914 Korong state by-election was held on 26 June 1914 to elect the next member for Korong in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the death of incumbent MP Thomas Langdon. en.s: The bombing of Kassa took place on 26 June 1941, when still unidentified aircraft conducted an airstrike on the city of Kassa, then a part of Hungary, today Košice in Slovakia. This attack became the pretext for the government of Hungary to declare war on the Soviet Union the next day, 27 June. On 26 June 1941, four days after Germany attacked the Soviet Union in violation of the Molotov–Ribbentrop non-aggression treaty, three unidentified planes bombed the city, killing and wounding over a dozen people and causing minor material damage. The true identity of the attacking nation has never been established.

zh.s: 1941年6月26日，三架身份不明的飞机轰炸了当时属于匈牙利、今属斯洛伐克的科希策（当时称卡萨），造成十余人死伤和轻微财产损失。这次袭击成为匈牙利政府次日对苏联宣战的借口。四天前，德国违反《莫洛托夫—里宾特洛甫互不侵犯条约》进攻苏联。发动袭击的国家至今未能确定。

en.t: Romanian Navy during World War II
en.s: The Romanian Navy during World War II was the main Axis naval force in the Black Sea campaigns and fought against the Soviet Union's Black Sea Fleet from 1941 to 1944. Operations consisted mainly of mine warfare, but there were also escort missions and localized naval engagements. The largest naval action fought by the Romanian Navy was the 26 June 1941 Raid on Constanța, and its most extensive operation was the 1944 evacuation of the Crimea.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，罗马尼亚海军是轴心国在黑海战役中的主要海军力量，1941年至1944年与苏联黑海舰队交战。其行动主要是水雷战，也包括护航任务及局部海战。罗马尼亚海军参与的最大规模海战是1941年6月26日康斯坦察港遭苏军袭击；范围最广的一次行动是1944年从克里米亚撤离人员。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 26 June 1949. Several reforms took effect prior to the elections; they were the first after the introduction of universal women's suffrage; the number of seats in the Chamber of Representatives was increased from 202 to 212, and from now on, elections for the nine provincial councils were held simultaneously with parliamentary elections. The number of Chamber seats and the simultaneous provincial and parliamentary elections would remain unchanged until state reforms in 1993. The result was a victory for the Christian Social Party, which won 105 of the 212 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 54 of the 106 seats in the Senate.

zh.s: 比利时于1949年6月26日举行大选。选举前实施了多项改革，这是女性获得普选权后举行的首次选举；众议院席位从202席增至212席，九个省议会选举也从此与议会选举同时举行。席位数量及省级、议会选举同步举行的安排一直维持到1993年国家改革。基督教社会党赢得众议院212席中的105席及参议院106席中的54席，取得胜利。

en.t: Austria v Switzerland (1954 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: On June 26, 1954, in a quarterfinal match of the 1954 Football World Cup, Austria beat Switzerland 7–5 in Lausanne, Switzerland. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 266 seats in the Senate. No party had secured a majority in the 2015 election, resulting in the most fragmented parliament since 1977. Ensuing negotiations failed to produce a stable governing coalition, paving the way for a repeat election on 26 June. The political deadlock marked the first time that a Spanish election was triggered due to failure in the government formation process.

zh.s: 2016年西班牙大选于6月26日（星期日）举行，选出西班牙王国第12届议会。众议院全部350席和参议院266席中的208席进行改选。2015年大选后没有政党取得多数，议会分裂程度创1977年以来新高。此后的组阁谈判未能组成稳定的执政联盟，因此再次举行大选。此次政治僵局使西班牙首次因组阁失败而重新选举。
